responsibility: This definition module declares a Logitech-compatible delay service for GNU Modula-2. It exposes a single procedure that suspends execution for an approximate number of milliseconds, providing a simple timing primitive for legacy applications.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the Delay pair: it exposes the single public procedure signature Delay(milliSec: INTEGER), while Delay.mod contains the timeout-based implementation using Selective.
